question: Who holds sellers' money between the buyer's payment and the seller's payout?
answer: C, in every market at launch: each payment method's provider holds it, in the seller's own account with that provider; the seller's courier for cash on delivery; paid by transfer or in cash, it goes to the seller
evidence: studies/subjects/S-01/analysis.tsv S01-VP-01 (vendor choice; coexistence salla=A, zid=A, shopify=A+B, bigcommerce=B, woocommerce=A+B); own services conditional by market: observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/help-center/help.shopify.com@en-ar/md/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments.md L9, observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/help-center/help.shopify.com@en-ar/md/en/manual/payments/third-party-providers/payment-gateway-availability.md L17, observed-sa@4ca2e896a729215f422a137a364e7e9488610ba3:structures/salla/help-articles/en/texts.jsonl records 651 and 566; sellers' own providers and offline payment in both: observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/help-center/help.shopify.com@en-ar/md/en/manual/payments/third-party-providers/configuring-providers.md L30, observed-sa@4ca2e896a729215f422a137a364e7e9488610ba3:structures/salla/help-articles/en/texts.jsonl record 318, observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/help-center/help.shopify.com@en-ar/md/en/manual/payments/manual-payments.md L10, observed-sa@4ca2e896a729215f422a137a364e7e9488610ba3:structures/salla/help-articles/en/texts.jsonl record 495; Yemen: YK-203, YA-131, YE-E765, YA-62 (corrected), YA-102 (caution), YK-515 (corrected)
alternatives: A: Sharrwah holds a balance per seller (needs a ledger, collection into Sharrwah's accounts, payouts, reconciliation, and a licence where the market requires one); B: a processor holds, in accounts opened through Sharrwah; defer: only the interface
trade_off: No platform payment service at launch: sellers open their own provider accounts, and Sharrwah nets no fees from sales. In return Sharrwah holds no sellers' money, needs no licence to hold it, and carries none of its liability
rationale_at: studies/subjects/S-01/decision-1.md, 'Recommendation: C, in every market at launch'; studies/subjects/S-01/entry.md, 'Decision 1'; its Yemen row: reports/S-01-review.md, 'The Yemen row'
reopens_when: the founder switches on A or B in a market

question: Default 1: an account a seller requests through Sharrwah
answer: Counts as C when the seller holds it under its own agreement with the provider; where Sharrwah would be party to the money, or to the provider's agreement for it, it is B and comes to the founder
evidence: observed-sa@4ca2e896a729215f422a137a364e7e9488610ba3:structures/salla/help-articles/en/texts.jsonl record 576 (Tabby: 'request a new Tabby Business account through Salla'; 'Fees depend on the agreement between the merchant and Tabby'); observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/help-center/help.shopify.com@en-ar/md/en/manual/payments/paypal/set-up-paypal.md L3
alternatives: Treat every account opened through Sharrwah as B, as the guard's literal words would
trade_off: Sharrwah can bring sellers to providers without being party to their money; the line depends on each provider's agreement, read one by one
rationale_at: studies/subjects/S-01/decision-1.md, 'Three edges of C', 1
reopens_when: a provider's agreement makes Sharrwah a party

question: Default 2: how Sharrwah collects its own fees
answer: Billed apart, by invoice or card; never taken from sellers' money at a provider
evidence: observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/help-center/help.shopify.com@en-ar/md/en/manual/payments/getting-paid.md L11 ('If you don't activate Shopify Payments as your payment provider, then you're charged third-party transaction fees for all orders that aren't brokered financially by Shopify'); observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/help-center/help.shopify.com@en-ar/md/en/manual/your-account/manage-billing/billing-charges/types-of-charges.md L8 (transaction fees on the Shopify bill) and L12 (Shopify Payments fees deducted from payouts); observed-sa@4ca2e896a729215f422a137a364e7e9488610ba3:structures/salla/dashboard-translations/en/payments.json (financing collected from sales Salla holds)
alternatives: Deduct fees from sellers' money at a provider, which needs an agreement Sharrwah is party to (B's side)
trade_off: Sharrwah bears collection risk on its invoices and can't net fees from sales; it stays out of sellers' money
rationale_at: studies/subjects/S-01/decision-1.md, 'Three edges of C', 2
status: settled by the founder, 25 October 2026, at launch; whether 'never' reaches past launch is for the founder to confirm
reopens_when: B is switched on in a market: deducting there is part of B

question: How a payment is recorded, whoever holds the money
answer: An order's payment record is the same whoever holds the money. A holder's ledger (balance, holds, payouts) is a separate part, present only where Sharrwah or a processor holds. Under C, a provider's balance, where shown, is read from the provider; Sharrwah keeps no ledger of it
evidence: observed-sh@febbf6c98a1f2a464bb92bd97856b8ba070f3185:structures/shopify/admin-graphql-schema/2026-10/items.jsonl: OrderTransaction L2447 (gateway, manualPaymentGateway, the optional shopifyPaymentsSet), ShopifyPaymentsAccount L3193 (balance, balanceTransactions, payouts, payoutSchedule, disputes), ShopifyPaymentsBalanceTransaction L3197 (sourceOrderTransactionId); observed-sa@4ca2e896a729215f422a137a364e7e9488610ba3:structures/salla/docs-operations/md-openapi/items.jsonl: L64 POST /settlements/instant ('temporarily withhold a specific amount of money for settlement from the Merchant's wallet', for dropshipping applications only), L211 PUT /transactions/{transaction_id} ('The store must have enough balance to process the refund amounts')
alternatives: Bind C now: one record per payment and no holder ledger, so A or B later reworks orders and refunds; or one record where payments post into a seller balance, Salla's shape
trade_off: Two kinds of record instead of one, in a design not yet written. In return, A or B later adds the ledger and onboarding without reworking orders, as Shopify runs its own service beside third-party providers
rationale_at: reports/S-01-review.md, 'Premature constraints'
status: proposed: the founder's to decide (PLAN.md, section 3, item 3; founder-decisions.tsv, the guard: whether the design provides for A or B)
